posts.name: Craig
posts.cooked:
It's that time of year again! We're looking for volunteers at Gen Con in Indianapolis and PAX Prime in Seattle. All we ask is for some of your time and your absolute devotion in return for a badge and time with the greatest booth at the show.

If you would like to sign up or if you have any questions, send me an email! I'm craig@greaterthangames.com.

2015 is going to be a great year for conventions. Don't miss a chance to see it up close.
